relationships.subject: Caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Assembly of this complex enables mature caspase-1 to convert pro-IL-18 into its active form, allowing the inflammatory cytokine to be secreted out into the extracellular matrix (ECM).

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: Once primed and activated, NLRP3 proteins oligomerize and recruit ASC, which mediates the conversion of pro-caspase-1 into its catalytically active form, caspase-1

relationships.subject: IL-18BP
relationships.evidence_quote: The binding proteins’ primary function is to bind and neutralize free IL-18, preventing the cytokine from binding to its receptor and triggering an inflammatory response

relationships.subject: IL-18
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, IL-18 induces neutrophils to release the proinflammatory cytokines IL-1α and TNF-α as well as the chemokine IL-8

key_findings: IL-18 peaks 7 days post-SCI, later than other pro-inflammatory cytokines, driven by NLRP3 inflammasome.
Microglia are primary IL-18 producers and astrocytes primary responders; NLRP3 inhibition or IL-18 neutralization improves recovery.
